purpose: First practical assortment for the Crystal design workbench. Supplier progression is intentionally paused. This is a design/selection layer, not a purchase list.
principles: Prioritize material quality, optical interest, shape language and structural composition over generic same-size round-bead repetition.
Keep the initial assortment compact enough to design with: core materials first, then design extensions and signature/one-of-one focal materials.
Use no more than 3-4 core material species in a single design unless a deliberate controlled-maximalism concept requires more.
Silver is the default hardware language; gold-tone hardware is not a V1 core requirement.
Packaging should be quiet, modern and material-led, without mystical/healing/ritual cues.
Existing supplier, price and verification data remain available in the database but are not the focus of this assortment view.

mineral_selection.name: Clear Quartz
mineral_selection.selection_note: High-clarity pieces matter more than generic abundance; use geometric or irregular pieces to create structure.

mineral_selection.name: Smoky Quartz
mineral_selection.selection_note: Useful as a quiet dark anchor; avoid making the whole bracelet uniformly brown-grey.

mineral_selection.name: Aquamarine
mineral_selection.selection_note: One of the strongest cool-blue core materials. Separate pale translucent body beads from higher-optical-quality focal pieces.

mineral_selection.name: Labradorite
mineral_selection.selection_note: Flash and surface character are the selection criteria; dark low-flash beads should not be priced or positioned like strong-flash focal material.

mineral_selection.name: Rainbow Moonstone
mineral_selection.selection_note: Use as light and air rather than making every piece the visual hero.

mineral_selection.name: Amazonite
mineral_selection.selection_note: Prefer muted mineral blue-green and visible natural variation over saturated candy-like color.

mineral_selection.name: Lapis Lazuli
mineral_selection.selection_note: Use deep blue as a controlled anchor; strong gold-speckled or overly uniform material should be treated as a separate visual variant.

mineral_selection.name: Green Phantom Quartz
mineral_selection.selection_note: Inclusion visibility and internal landscape are more important than nominal size.

mineral_selection.name: Obsidian
mineral_selection.selection_note: Use as black punctuation or structure, not as a full generic black-bead bracelet.

mineral_selection.name: Amethyst
mineral_selection.selection_note: Favor grey-violet, smoky-violet or clear mineral tones over very saturated purple.

mineral_selection.name: Citrine
mineral_selection.selection_note: Keep warm tones mineral and restrained; avoid orange/yellow combinations that read as costume jewelry.

mineral_selection.name: Tiger's Eye
mineral_selection.selection_note: Select for chatoyancy and dark-brown/gold depth; use as a structural accent rather than a conventional full strand.

mineral_selection.name: Blue Lace Agate
mineral_selection.selection_note: Useful for pale blue-white transitions and quieter designs.

mineral_selection.name: Kunzite
mineral_selection.selection_note: Prefer cool pale pink-lilac transparency; avoid candy-pink presentation.

mineral_selection.name: Bloodstone
mineral_selection.selection_note: Good for earthy geological composition when paired with quiet silver or dark wood.

mineral_selection.name: White Phantom Quartz
mineral_selection.selection_note: Treat internal structure as the design content; do not mix with too many other inclusion-heavy minerals.

mineral_selection.name: Rose Quartz
mineral_selection.selection_note: Use only in restrained, low-saturation pink compositions; not a default healing-crystal aesthetic.

mineral_selection.name: Rainbow Obsidian
mineral_selection.selection_note: Only worth carrying when the sheen is visually legible; ordinary black material belongs under Obsidian.

mineral_selection.name: Larimar
mineral_selection.selection_note: Reserve better pattern and color pieces for compact focal zones; do not distribute expensive focal material evenly around the bracelet.

mineral_selection.name: Gold Rutilated Quartz
mineral_selection.selection_note: Need visible rutile composition and enough transparency; strong focal use only.

mineral_selection.name: Black Rutilated Quartz
mineral_selection.selection_note: Use where dark inclusions remain readable through the crystal body; suited to silver-framed focal treatments.

mineral_selection.name: Rutilated Quartz
mineral_selection.selection_note: Generic parent for mixed-rutile material; preserve visible source variation rather than forcing it into gold/black subtypes.

mineral_selection.name: Sugilite
mineral_selection.selection_note: Use selectively as a deep mineral-purple focal; avoid large areas of uniform saturated purple.

mineral_selection.name: Aquamarine / collector focal grade
mineral_selection.selection_note: This is a quality/form tier of Aquamarine, not a second material identity. Workbench should keep it as a selection specification overlay.

pearls_and_organic.name: White freshwater pearl
pearls_and_organic.selection_note: Use in small clusters or rhythm breaks; avoid generic pearl-bracelet dominance.

pearls_and_organic.name: White South Sea Pearl
pearls_and_organic.selection_note: Use as one or a few focal elements, not a full strand for this project language.

pearls_and_organic.name: Golden South Sea Pearl
pearls_and_organic.selection_note: Signature Sunrise focal only; not part of the default cool/silver system.

pearls_and_organic.name: Dark wood / agarwood-like structural spacer
pearls_and_organic.selection_note: Use as structural texture. Avoid large standard wooden rounds that make the design read as a conventional Buddhist/ethnic bead bracelet.

hardware_selection.name: 925 sterling silver curved tube
hardware_selection.spec: 20-30mm length class; clean curve; no ornate engraving

hardware_selection.name: 925 sterling silver thin frame / bezel
hardware_selection.spec: oval/freeform/polygon stone framing; thin profile; open or visually light construction

hardware_selection.name: 925 sterling silver half-cap / edge-cap
hardware_selection.spec: for irregular or focal minerals; restrained geometry

hardware_selection.name: 925 sterling silver geometric connector
hardware_selection.spec: bar/block/ring geometry; small scale; no ornate motif

hardware_selection.name: 925 sterling silver small round counterweight
hardware_selection.spec: approximately 5-8mm visual scale, smooth or lightly textured

hardware_selection.name: 925 sterling silver fine chain + minimal clasp
hardware_selection.spec: thin chain, minimal clasp, suitable only for non-elastic constructions

hardware_selection.name: 925 sterling silver micro organic charm
hardware_selection.spec: small leaf/botanical/abstract form; secondary only, never the main product story

hardware_selection.name: Oxidized / blackened sterling silver micro accent
hardware_selection.spec: small-scale only; use to connect dark mineral palettes

hardware_selection.name: Gold-tone hardware
hardware_selection.spec: Do not build V1 around gold plating. Revisit only for explicit Sunrise or Black-Gold capsule designs.

packaging_selection.name: Compact matte white rigid presentation box
packaging_selection.spec: clean white or cool off-white, matte/soft-touch or fine paper texture, compact interior, no visible gold trim

packaging_selection.name: Cool grey rigid drawer box
packaging_selection.spec: stone grey / blue-grey, low-saturation, restrained typography, removable insert

packaging_selection.name: Soft grey or pearl-white protective pouch
packaging_selection.spec: non-shedding, low-lint fabric; avoid heavy black velvet as default

packaging_selection.name: Cotton-linen envelope pouch
packaging_selection.spec: natural but refined weave, cool beige/grey preferred over rustic brown

packaging_selection.name: Book-style magnetic box
packaging_selection.spec: minimal exterior, no ritual/mystical graphics, space for material card and one-of-one certificate

packaging_selection.name: Material disclosure + care card
packaging_selection.spec: state material names/status and care; no healing/energy claims; visually editorial, not mystical

packaging_selection.name: One-of-One certificate card
packaging_selection.spec: record design code, material composition, date/batch and visible uniqueness notes; do not claim unverifiable geology/authenticity

packaging_selection.name: Branded shipping mailer
packaging_selection.spec: plain protective exterior, compact, recyclable preference where practical; presentation box remains the visual product layer

deprioritize: Large inventory of identical 8mm round strands with no role/shape distinction
Rainbow/chakra multi-color mixes as a default product language
Large ornate zodiac/animal/ethnic charms as primary focal elements
Low-cost plated alloy findings presented as premium hardware
Heavy black velvet + gold luxury packaging as the default brand system
Healing/energy/ritual packaging copy or product claims
Buying many mineral species before shape/form/quality coverage of the core assortment is sufficient
